headline: Mooring and Weathered See Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: Since the last edition, MooringCountyHex has become still busier on the ownership ledger, recording 37 base events in twenty-four hours against 35 previously and five in the latest six-hour span. Its holdings now stand at eleven Warden bases and one Colonial, while the sharpest casualty and enlistment rates have cooled. WeatheredExpanseHex likewise advances to 39 daily events, including three in the latest two hours; its balance has shifted to five Warden and four Colonial bases, with no neutral sites, though combat tempo is easing. StlicanShelfHex shows a modest rise to eleven events, with two in six hours and no fresh action in the latest two. StonecradleHex remains at seventeen daily events but has gone quiet for six hours. PalantineBermHex has climbed from three to six events, all centered on Leiri Hermanni, without a two-hour change. A new flashpoint appears in LinnMercyHex, where Rotdust produced three events in the last day, including a very recent ownership sequence. FarranacCoastHex has cooled to five daily events and no recent movement.
